'''Novoanov''' is a political center in the [[Duchy of Ledostrov]] and the city most closely associated with the [[Duma of Ledostrov]].

== Constitutional Role ==

In 1352, the noble council elevated the [[Prince of Novoanov]] and signed the [[Anavaisk-Novoanov Accords]], creating the Duma. Novoanov became the main stage for noble politics, budget disputes, and later constitutional crises.

== Twentieth-Century Crisis ==

In 1938, the [[Burgrave of Sedava]] attempted to march on the Duma in Novoanov during the famine crisis, but his supporters were stopped before they could overturn the noble order. In the later collapse of the [[Pentarchy of Ledostrov]], [[Reznikoff of Ledostrov]] marched on Novoanov and entered the city as the Pentarchy disintegrated.
